description: Item icons, rarity frames and the popup panel of the dungeon result sample (Content/Samples/DungeonUi). Until the images arrive, reward slots draw the fallback shapes of the item table, and common and uncommon slots keep their drawn outline.
style: Follow the frozen UI style in Art/Style/ui_style.md, with the style frame and the baseline captures in references: dark translucent navy panels with thin lines, cyan accents, gold only for rank, currency and rewards, painted icons with light from the top left. No text, logos or watermarks.

items.subject: Reward slot frame for rare items: blue metal border with small studs in the corners and a transparent middle
items.usedBy: /Game/Samples/DungeonUi/Data/DA_DungeonUiTheme: property Rare.Frame (DrawAs Box, Margin 0.1875), drawn by the Frame border of WBP_RewardSlot over its Fill border
items.feedback: Layout: Slate draws 9-slice margins at the texture's pixel size, so the 128 px frame drew a 24 unit border over the slot content; the request is now 64 px with a 12 px border that starts at the image edge and ends inside the 8/10 unit inset. Style: it does not match the icons or the sample UI. The draft kit in Art/Style/ui_style.md draws slot frames with brushes, so this item goes away if the kit is approved.
